digest.component_or_area: tracker initialization and environment identity management
propositions: Fresh tracker re-clone regenerates .env-id without checking for existing events, silently creating a new environment identity that orphans all prior attestations signed by the old identity

Minting .env-id into a store containing events from another environment must warn loudly on stderr, naming the prior env id(s), the attestation consequence, and the git-ignored files to carry over, but still complete to allow multi-clone workflows

rebar fsck must emit a counted ENV_ID_MISMATCH issue when the current environment's own authors have also written events under a different env id, without false positives on healthy multi-clone topologies with multiple authors
The override env var REBAR_ALLOW_ENV_REIDENTIFY=1 acknowledges the re-identification situation, quietens the warning to a one-line note, and allows the mint to proceed
